title: Like tying my hair with telephone cord
text:
Like tying my hair with telephone cord. There are eight spiral ties in this package. They also do not look exactly the same size and one of them is a different color brown. However, these do not work like the great [[ASIN:B08HQYH3H Goomee Spiral Hair Ties]] I love.

These feel like I am tying up my hair with telephone cord. It is difficult to use these and not that easy to remove. Also, they do not hold well. I personally do not like these at all.

product_metadata.title: MJIYA Hair Ties, Coil Hair Ties, Phone Cord Hair Ties, Hair Coils Elastic Hair Band with Strong Grip (8 PCS, Brown)
